I did not have a good experience here. Years ago, before I had a gluten allergy, I dined at the Suffolk location and loved the food and service. Now that I have an allergy I’m very mindful about where I eat. I called ahead to the Norfolk location and asked if they had any gluten-free options and was reassured that they could “make anything on the menu gluten free” I took that loosely because usually restaurants don’t have separate gluten free friers so my expectation was that I could perhaps get a burger with no bun, grilled wings, or a rice bowl. A few hours later I went with my husband and we were seated within a couple minutes. When trying to order I asked the waitress if their wings or burger patties were gluten free. She said let me go check and see and came back with a no. Then I asked what they had that was gluten free expecting there would be another option based on my earlier phone call to the restaurant. She went back and asked the cook and he said nothing in the restaurant was gluten free. We drove 30 minutes just to have to leave. The waitress was sweet and I could tell she felt bad but there wasn’t anything else to be done. My husband enjoyed his basil lemonade and she comped it but the overall experience was disappointing because I never would’ve driven that far knowing that there wouldn’t be anything for me to eat. I don’t expect restaurants to cater to my allergy but if I’m told on the phone very confidently that there is gluten free food for me and then we waste time and gas to go I feel pretty frustrated. If you don’t have an allergy this restaurant may be a good choice but I likely won’t be going back which is disappointing.

Thai peanut salad is outstanding, dressing is particularly wonderful. Nduja flavorful and unique, especially over perfectly-toasted sourdough. Prosciutto and onion tart another exquisite amalgamation of complementary flavors, certainly not too blue-cheesy if that's a concern like it sometimes is for us. Brussels perfectly crispy and savory with accompanying crushed peanuts and nuoc cham. Cauliflower a canvas for a balanced combination of robust, yet not overpowering, spices and flavors. Potato pancake was just a touch bland, the only source of disappointment with the food. Burger and Fett are must-try house specialties, both bursting with savory flavor and expertly-prepared. All three desserts are great options depending on your preference, especially decadent toffee pudding with perfect whipped cream and salted toffee sauce. Drinks were slightly disappointing, seemed like a small amount for the price point, with a neat but voluminous rectangular prism ice cube taking up so much of some of the glasses. Coffee Spritz, Algonquin, and Downtown Revival cocktails are all well-crafted, unique and carefully balanced with lots of flavors that work well together, each subtly present and not overpowering the others. Holy cow. The food was fantastic. I had a Philly Roll and hot sake to start and ended with some Ramen. Delicious. Will definitely come back and recommend. Staff was also good with getting our order correct and friendly.

First off the server was very nice, but that is the only positive thing I can say.  I am an ODU alum so familiar with the place. The cleanliness is awful, sticky tables, soy sauce bottles and benches. There were 3 ladies behind the counter and the place was empty so why couldn't they wipe tables? They have Japanese style noren drapes  leading to the bathroom and to the kitchen. These were absolutely filthy, and to use the restroom, also not clean- you have to pass through it.. The  gyoza had a funny aftertaste and ramen was just not good. Such a shame, such space and potential. I'm sure people would travel to go there for a goid product.But they must be focusing on  grubhub.

Ordered Uber Eats from here and was probably the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Harris Teeter sushi is better than this. Ordered the Hott Lady Roll and Spicy Tuna Roll and the inside of them look exactly the same. It’s fish and filler mixed together into a log. Pretty unappetizing. Could only tolerate one piece of each. Expected fresher ingredients for the price. Won’t be eating here again.

The Gyoza and O-Katsu ramen were an absolutely comfort meal for these past chilly weeks we’ve had! The pork and herbs in the gyoza has been one of the best I’ve had in the area so far. And the katsu ramen is quite filling and definitely worth splitting between two people as the cutlet is massive. Definitely one of my favorites aside from Kappo Nara!
customer_insights: Osaka Ramen and Sushi has received mixed reviews, with many customers expressing dissatisfaction with the sushi quality and service. While some patrons enjoyed the ramen and gyoza, the overall cleanliness and consistency of the food have been points of concern. It may be suitable for casual dining or group outings, but not recommended for special occasions.

address: The Gunton Arms, Norwich NR11 8TZ, UK
googleReviews: Fabulous place. If you're looking for a romantic break or a break with friends this is the place. So cozy so atmospheric. Food outstanding. The chef cooks the meat on a open fire to absolute perfection every time. Staff super friendly. Rooms fantastic. Thanks for a great break.

Had a lovely lunch here and tried the venison which is from the estate. The food quality was great, as was the service but the whole vibe with the fire and decor is what makes this place! It’s a lovely atmosphere and the definition of cosy. I highly recommend if in the area ❤️

Having recently moved to the area we noticed that this place keeps winning awards so thought it worth a visit to see why.

And from the majestic approach along the driveway we started to see why.  The building exterior is stunning, and as you step inside it gives you a real hug.

The service was attentive and friendly throughout and the food… just amazing.  An interesting menu with something for everyone, delicious food, cooked with love and so well-presented.

We’ll be back!

A bit disappointed! Food excellent, staff friendly, had table from 6-8pm but at 5 minutes to 8 asked to pay and move to the bar with our coffee. They didn’t offer to take our drinks and there wasn’t a table available!! We were a bit cold because we weren’t in a room with a lit fire and the seating is very uncomfortable. Cushions on the hard wooden seats are desperately needed!! Noted poor outside lighting.

You park in a very large car park and enter the grounds of Gunton House via a steel gate. About 100m ahead is the Gunton Arms. As we approached the pub we could see a herd of deer, some with large set of antlers. Not your everyday pub this.
Warm greeting and taken through to our table. This is a dog friendly place and we had taken our cocker spaniel with us to enjoy our anniversary meal.
The food was very tasty.
We were in a back area where there is less light. At times it was a little dark for us, we are in our late 60s, the table candle not quite bright enough. Very romantic as it was.
We had said it was our anniversary and they left a card for us wishing us all the best for our happy event.
They even placed a chocolate message on our dessert which was so sweet of them. My wife had already taken some of the letters off without realizing it was a message. 😂.
This chocolate torte with superb cherries was unbelievable.
Highly recommended on all counts, venue, service and food.
customer_insights: The Gunton Arms is a cozy and upscale dining venue known for its romantic atmosphere and exceptional food, particularly its meat dishes cooked over an open fire. While it is ideal for special occasions like anniversaries and first dates, it may not suit larger group outings or late-night gatherings.

venueName: Peck & Pour, World Class Wings and Beer
googleReviews: Stopped in on a Saturday afternoon for a quick pint and saw they think highly of their wings, so we grabbed a small order just to see. They were perfectly tasty, no reason not to get them, but not something I'd go out of my way for. The place was mostly empty so service was fast. They have a nice selection of beers and had a fun cocktail menu. Decor was a typical bar atmosphere, if I had to guess this place is probably popular with the ODU crowd.

I love their food here, especially their breaded hot honey wings! Their rice bowls look so good too, I highly recommend. Anne was a lovely server, so was Allegra and Alana, great staff, great location, and amazing food!

Update: Amanda and Anne are also so lovely. And their rice bowls are good! I really love the friendly ladies behind the bar and their cesar dressing must be made in house. Their cesar salad is simple and DELICIOUS. I love it here. Cant wait to be back.
Love this place. Rainy night, but I wanted to venture out. Fun straight-up bar. Wings apps and beer. Great outdoor space, fun indoor space. Bar is big with wine beer and mix drinks.
4 of my 6  mozzarella sticks literally have no cheese, thank for wasting 40 minutes and my money. Second time Ive been there to waste my time and money, Highly DO NOT recommend!

Stopped in for dinner, we got the wing platter, the mozzarella sticks were absolutely nasty; the wings jumbo.  , have flavor , just bad quality meat . The floor was very sticky in the dining area. Overall this was a bad experience. . The drinks took 15-20 min to come out, I wouldn’t recommend.  Honestly you can make better food in a microwave
customer_insights: Peck & Pour is a casual sports bar known for its wings and beer selection, appealing mainly to the ODU crowd. While the atmosphere is lively and suitable for pregame or casual outings, there are mixed reviews regarding food quality and service consistency.

address: 4848 Virginia Beach Blvd, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, USA
googleReviews: DJ  is same on all Karaoke nights: likes to hear himself sing.. Plays songs when singers are waiting. Only has 1 mic.  Bren, waitress is fantastic and beautiful.   Food prices increased and menu never changed during the year of going there every weekend. Miss going there but not with the  problems described.

Service was great.  We used to go every weekend for Karokee.  One D J  same on both nights.  Worries more about himself singing  then guests.  Same old  music.  Prices on food was raised.  Nothing new on menu.

Had the sampler, price was right, the sauces were standard, the fries were a bit bland.
Over all  not bad , they have foot ball specials all week long 25 cent wings during games, that a plus..
2 stars..

Came in while it was open. Knew a hole in the wall will be less busy which I was correct. Wanted to chill and have a good time. No time displayed saying they was closing soon (12am).  We thought they close at 2 as the other hole in the wall. We left when we was told we close in 5 minutes after we asked for change to play pool. We left at the beginning of the
game because we felt super uncomfortable. When we left, we asked a guy outside smoking if he is a manger, he said yes. We asked why isn’t there a sign of your open to close time, he said you should of asked. Great answer manager.

DO NOT COME HERE!
customer_insights: The Frog Sports Bar & Grill offers a casual and lively atmosphere ideal for sports fans and karaoke enthusiasts. However, there are significant concerns regarding service quality, food pricing, and inclusivity, which may deter potential patrons.

address: 2330 Bowdens Ferry Rd Suite 600, Norfolk, VA 23508, USA
googleReviews:
Had an amazing experience at the Afterglow winter market! Loved seeing the community come out and shop at all the local business vendors!

Amazing back patio by the railroads (safe for kids!), tons of parking, super family & pet friendly, amazing staff, even better atmosphere!

Can't wait to go back and get a Holy Cannoli!

6/6/25 - Nice spacious area outside by the railroad tracks. I went during a flea market event. Parking was a little slim due to the event.  They had 2 different food trucks. It seems they have a signature frozen drink but I was unable to get. I was told ten minutes and already ordered another drink and the people next to us just ordered it and were able to get it, which kind of annoyed me. 🫣 The line starts at the entry of the front door. There is some merch by the front door as well. They did have an additional outdoor bar with only a selection drinks. But the staff was nice. The outdoor space is very spacious. I didn't get to try any foods but would still come back for the outdoor seating/environment.

Nice, friendly venue with live music and tonight the Food Truck for eats was AMAZING! 757LoasStrretFood 😋 The Meat Salad, the Pancit, the Rubbed Wings, the Pork Eggrolls, the Chicken Skewers...ALL DELICIOUS!!! 😋

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!
Beer is amazing I can drink them all. Staff was very friendly and attentive. Outdoor space is great plenty of room for kids to play.

We had a great time at Afterglow. The brewery is modern, clean, and welcoming on the inside. They have a great outdoor space and a tented patio which was perfect on a rainy day. I’m not a huge beer drinker but the bartender was able to recommend some beers for me to try. I ended up getting a flight and enjoyed each one. They have a diverse menu so there is something for everyone. The seltzers were also so good and they had lots of flavors to choose from. It’s definitely family friendly and I felt comfortable with my infant there (bonus points for the clean changing tables in both bathrooms). They have some games and activities for older kids as well. We’ll definitely be coming back!
customer_insights: Afterglow Brewing is a family-friendly brewery with a spacious outdoor area and a welcoming atmosphere. Customers appreciate the live music, food trucks, and community events, making it a great spot for casual gatherings with friends and family.

googleReviews: Vast beer selections with many different styles. I had the Goatskull dopple bock and then the Holiday Helper. Both beers were excellent and flavorful. They had two different food trucks outside and some chicken quesadillas hit the spot. There was a small local craft fair going on this day in the larger side room where I picked up some gifts and connected with some new friends. This is a unique big little brewery where it’s hard not to have a good time.
Love Smartmouth!! Bummed the Norfolk location is closing but the Pilot House in VB is great, as well! Pizza is on-site at the Pilot House and the atmosphere is always nice!

Convenient location with many flavorful takes on lagers, IPAs, other styles. The seasonal offerings are usually on-point and haven’t disappointed us yet. The atmosphere is congenial with a generational mix of folks. Missed their Alter Ego Saison, but the other beers are worth trying.
Cool place with great beer and a fun enviroment. Me and my brother won a best of three games series of foosball during my visit. A triumphant experience that we will never forget.

Smartmouth has awesome beers and a great atmosphere. They are taking the social distancing seriously with masks requires, hand sanitizer available and spaced out tables indoors and out with open air in the garage. The employees are super nice and very attentive to cleaning. Great location and easy to walk to if you are local. Pups are allowed as well. Same for the little ones. Definitely would recommend!
customer_insights: Smartmouth Brewing Co. offers a vibrant atmosphere with a diverse selection of craft beers and food trucks, making it a popular spot for social gatherings. The brewery is known for its friendly environment and community events, appealing to both locals and visitors looking for a fun night out.

googleReviews: The atmosphere of this brewery is wonderful — warm and inviting. The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff was very polite and attentive. The location is excellent, making it a perfect spot to enjoy both great flavors and a great setting. I usually never drink beer — maybe once a year — but even I tried a couple of sips here, and it was surprisingly delicious!
My colleagues and I frequent Elations for lunch and it's one of our to-go places for evening get togethers. Staff is always friendly and I have enjoyed all of the variety of pizzas so far.

We were tourists visiting from Canada and out for a bike ride and came upon this fabulous spot for lunch. It’s a great place for families and friends to get together. Dog friendly as well. Children were playing and having fun while live band played in the background. The pizzas are amazing and the beer selection is great. The staff were fabulous as well.
Pizza is good but you can get the exact same pizza with better service at the bake house on Chelsea. They really miss the mark with the service here. Voyager coffee shop on the other hand is great.

Great beer, the whole place smells amazing with the combination of the pizza and the smoked meats.
We walked in tonight to a great rock band. The place was crowded (Friday night) but the staff was extremely accommodating in helping us find a seat.
Parking unfortunately is not great. Currently they allow parking across the street at 5215 Colley Ave
customer_insights: Elation Brewing is a vibrant and inviting brewery in Norfolk, known for its delicious pizzas and great beer selection. The atmosphere is lively, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists, with live music enhancing the experience. While some reviews mention service inconsistencies, the overall sentiment highlights a friendly staff and a welcoming environment.

googleReviews: Great little micro brewery in a cool area of Norfolk. My favorite beer was the Tunnel Traffic but they were all delicious. Friendly staff, clean bathrooms, close to lots of other breweries and restaurants.

I highly recommend this place. Rip Rap was a very nice brewery which presented a much different experience than normal. A very relaxed atmosphere with plenty of seating for the day we went. All inside seating, unfortunately no food or food truck on site. However, they had all sorts of games available to play and cheap merchandise. Will be returning here in the near future

Beer was good and reasonably priced, atmosphere is fairly sparse and small. Couple adirondack chairs in front allow you to take in the view of the heating and air conditioning place across the street. Website could use some updating, adding a pic of the menu so folks know what they have on draft here.
This place is a fantastic place to relax and get a beer. It is small and homey. One of the better places to get a beer in Norfolk. 10/10!
The space and vibe reminded me of hanging out in a friend's garage, super laid back and inviting. We tried the red IPA and the peach gose and both were great. Definitely will be back!
customer_insights: Rip Rap Brewing Co. offers a relaxed and inviting atmosphere, making it a great spot for casual hangouts. While it lacks food options, the variety of beers and games available create a fun environment for friends looking to unwind.
